items.title: Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia after attack on drone maker
items.standfirst: Authorities say Russian intelligence service ordered attack which Estonian PM links to Tallinn’s support for Ukraine Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 December after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker in the Baltic state over the weekend, which authorities said was ordered by Russia’s GRU military intelligence service.On Saturday morning, eight people were detained during an attempted attack on Threod Systems, a defence company that manufactures long-range attack and reconnaissance drones. items.title: Xi, Trump and Putin to discuss 'world peace' at Shenzhen summit, China says
items.standfirst: The Chinese foreign ministry on Monday said that President Xi Jinping and his US and Russian counterparts Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin would discuss "safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability" when they hold their first trilateral summit in Shenzhen this week. The meeting is expected to happen on Thursday on the sidelines of a summit of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders.

items.title: Elon Musk, Uber co-founder join calls to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia chief
items.standfirst: Elon Musk and an Uber co-founder were among more than 158,000 signatories by Sunday demanding Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia chief pending an independent investigation. Huang resigned Thursday after revelations of two extramarital affairs, one with a subordinate and another with a woman accused of spying for China, ending his 33-year tenure.

items.title: Yemen's Houthis advance on Aden as government forces retreat to defend their capital
items.standfirst: Houthi forces in Yemen have advanced to within 60 kilometres of Aden, the seat of the country's internationally recognised government, military and government sources said Sunday. The embattled government earlier announced it was pulling back its last forces from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to defend its temporary capital on the southern coast of Yemen.

items.title: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, architect of Mexico’s drug trade, dies age 80
items.standfirst: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, a founder of Mexico’s Guadalajara cartel known as the “boss of bosses”, died in hospital on Sunday aged 80 after suffering multiple organ failure, Jalisco state’s security ministry said. items.title: Hundreds of thousands of Czechs protest in Prague over public media funding plan
items.standfirst: Hundreds of thousands of Czechs rallied in Prague on Sunday against government plans to replace public media fees with direct state funding, which critics say threatens broadcasters’ independence. Organisers said turnout exceeded a March protest of more than 200,000, potentially making it the largest demonstration since the 1989 Velvet Revolution.
